phases.title: Stable timing, fallback and latency
acceptance: Use a fixed output timeline with consistently aligned dry and wet paths
Report plugin latency accurately
Smooth dry/wet, fallback and recovery transitions
Pass variable-block, impulse-latency, delayed-worker and saturation tests
Expose bounded readiness, latency and overload telemetry

phases.title: Reliable controls, presets and standalone parity
acceptance: Preserve all latent values across prepare and device lifecycle changes
Bound and version state parsing and handle missing/superseded models visibly
Add standalone device selection, MIDI learn and versioned preset recall
Test more than eight latent dimensions through restore and audio processing
